title: Autoformalizing Argumentative Material Inferences
abstract: arXiv:2609.16991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural language arguments are compelling before they are formally explicit. A premise supports a claim through defeasible warrants, background commitments, and exception conditions that the text leaves implicit. However, formal verification requires the opposite. Making such arguments machine-checkable requires constructing the missing commitments, not only translating given sentences into logic. Construction, however, carries a risk that translation does not: a system free to add premises can make any claim provable, and a formally valid proof may assert the claim outright, prove it without the original premise, or establish more than the claim itself. We address this problem by formulating autoformalization for argumentative material inference as guard completion, in which non-monotonic material support is turned into monotonic formal inference relative to an explicitly constructed guard set. translated_title: 论证性实质推理的自动形式化
translated_abstract: 自然语言论证在被形式化明确之前就已经具有说服力。前提通过可废止的担保、背景承诺以及文本中隐含的例外条件来支持某个论断。然而，形式验证的要求恰恰相反。要使这类论证可被机器检验，需要构建缺失的承诺，而不仅仅是将给定的句子翻译成逻辑。然而，构建带有翻译所不具备的风险：一个可以自由添加前提的系统可以让任何论断都可被证明，而一个形式上有效的证明可能直接断言该论断、在缺乏原始前提的情况下证明它，或者证明了超出论断本身的内容。我们通过将论证性实质推理的自动形式化表述为守护条件补全（guard completion）来解决这一问题，即将非单调的实质性支持相对于显式构建的守护集合转化为单调的形式推理。只有当其证明…（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将论证性实质推理的自动形式化视为“守护条件补全”问题，通过显式构建守护集合，把非单调的实质性支持转化为单调的形式推理，从而在保证安全性的前提下使自然语言论证可被机器检验。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the autoformalization of argumentative material inference as guard completion, converting non-monotonic material support into monotonic formal inference relative to an explicitly constructed guard set, thereby enabling natural language arguments to be safely machine-checked.
